    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Bottom-row 5 markers identify the vertical columns to extend.
    for c, marker in enumerate(grid[-1]):
        if marker != 5:
            continue
        anchors = [(r, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        if not anchors:
            continue
        # Each gap takes the color of the next anchor below it; the
        # top and bottom tails take the nearest end anchor.
        for r in range(h):

            out[r][c] = color
